title: The body is indented
idea: The repeated step (the body) sits indented under the 'for each' line, just like the body of an if. Indentation shows what repeats.

exercises.prompt: In a loop, how do you show which step repeats?
options: Indent it under the 'for each' line
exercises.explanation: Indentation marks the body — the indented step is the one that repeats. You saw the same idea with if.

exercises.prompt: Indentation telling the computer 'this belongs inside' is the same idea you met with if.
exercises.explanation: Yes — indentation groups a block. Under an if it's 'do this when true'; under a loop it's 'repeat this'.
The indented print("Welcome") is the body. The 'for each' line sets up the repeat; the indented line is what repeats.
The indented body runs once per guest — three Welcome lines for three guests.

exercises.prompt: A line that is NOT indented under the loop...
options: Is not part of the repeat — it runs once, after the loop
exercises.explanation: Only indented lines repeat. An un-indented line after the loop runs once, when the loop is done.

exercises.prompt: Arrange these to make a loop that greets each guest.
exercises.explanation: The 'for each' header comes first, then the indented body beneath it. Header on top, body indented below.

exercises.prompt: Forgetting to indent the body would change which lines repeat.
exercises.explanation: Indentation IS the signal. No indent, no 'inside the loop' — just like with if. Spacing matters in Python.

exercises.prompt: Trace: for 2 guests, with body 'print("Hi")'. How many Hi lines?
exercises.explanation: Two guests, one Hi each — two lines. Count the things, count the body runs.

exercises.prompt: Match each part to its role.
exercises.explanation: Header sets up the repeat, the indented body repeats, and an un-indented line after runs once at the end.

exercises.prompt: Why does the loop body need to be indented?
options: So the computer knows exactly which step to repeat
To make it look pretty only
It does not need to be
exercises.explanation: Indentation tells the computer the boundary of the repeated block. Clear indentation = clear loop.
